about: Ratita Preview Center data (see PREVIEW.md). Builders edit this file: 'items' feed the posters + the Scheduled Additions board, 'previews' feed the Time Jumper. Live GitHub issue labels override 'stage' when the arcade is online.

items.name: Grok Pup Town (live)
items.what: Grok Pup Town: Candy's hometown, a cozy 3D dog town hub in HUBS & WORLDS, with bonus #34 Bone Dig and 3 Pup Town prizes. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Ratita Preview Center (live)
items.what: Lili's Preview Center behind the Food Court: posters, this board, the Time Jumper and bonus game #32 Chrono Courier.

items.name: Good Life Pack (live)
items.what: Grok Life Mini Pack: the Ratita Industries Gadget Shop with 8 working gadgets (Fix-It Hammer, RatPhone 5 drone delivery, Tablet remote work, Hover-Board, Bubble Shield and more) plus 5 Ratita outfits.

items.name: Super Kart Expansion (live)
items.what: Grok Kart Party Expansion: 4 new racers (Luna, Pi-rat, Snowie, Candy), Ratita Labs Raceway + Torty's Garden Grand Prix in the new Ratita Cup, staff ghosts with medals, and the 10-rung Ratita Challenge Ladder.

items.name: Pi-rat the Pirate Pack (live)
items.what: Grok Ratita Rescue MEGA: sail the Salty Cheddar with Captain Eye Patch and Grumbles to 5 islands (puzzles, hazards, 5 bosses, treasure) plus the Dresser Shop. 175 tickets in the DLC Shop. Its Time Jumper beta lives on in the Save Vault.

items.name: Midnight Express (live)
items.what: Grok Detective Expansion: who stole the Golden Cheese? 5 walk-in train cars, 6 suspects with alibis, fingerprint dusting, a clue corkboard, Disguise mode, co-op clue sharing and a big reveal.

items.name: Fiesta Fits (live)
items.what: Grok Land Party Mini Pack: 6 new skins (Ratita Mascot, Party-Hat Gus, Disco Astronaut and more), 6 hats, 6 trails, 4 dance emotes, a confetti cannon and a bouncy party horn.

items.name: Ratita HQ (live)
items.what: Grok Ratita Industries HQ: a 3D hub world in the new HUBS & WORLDS gallery section, bonus #33 Crumb Patrol and 3 HQ prizes.

items.name: Records Annex
items.what: The Hall of Game Records doubled: Uncle Barnaby, the Exhibit of the Week, a reading nook, a photo booth and seats.

previewsHelp: Playable work-in-progress snapshots for the Time Jumper. Only add one when it REALLY works. Make it with: node tools/make-preview.js <source-dir> <id> (see PREVIEW.md). Fields: id, game, issue, name, url (previews/<id>/ on this site), playable:true, built (date), notes.

archive.name: Grok Pup Town
archive.label: Final Beta (Time Jumper)
archive.notes: Early look! The whole town is walkable: square + fountain, 8 buildings to explore, Paw Park, the Golden Bone mystery and mini-games. Still being polished.

archive.name: Pi-rat the Pirate Pack
archive.label: Final Beta (Time Jumper)
archive.notes: Full campaign is playable: sail the Salty Cheddar, 5 islands, 5 bosses, Dresser Shop. Still polishing.

archiveHelp: Save Booth (Save Vault in the Preview Center): the LAST Time Jumper preview of every game that shipped, kept playable forever at archive/<id>-beta/ with its own grokBeta.<id>. save. Made with: node tools/make-preview.js --archive <id> (never delete previews). Each entry also shows in that game's Hall of Records Old Versions as 'Final Beta (Time Jumper)'.
